entry.title: Initial import
entry.content:
Initial import

A Make-driven data pipeline that filters Steam's whole catalogue down to the games
worth playing to learn German or Japanese, and that run on a Steam Machine. It joins
the FronkonGames dataset with Steam search, Valve's compatibility reports, SteamSpy
tags and the live store API, scores each game by how much language it makes the
player process, and renders the result as a CSV, a Markdown listing and a single-file
web app. This is the public copy; the private original keeps the development history.
